preparation.method: Actual Game/createSimulationRuntime model replay, fixed legal commands, direct synthetic group-final ACKs only in prep; no native outputs

finalRuntimeStats.presentationContract: K4 composite final endpoint, interior tick endpoints not individually exposed
finalRuntimeStats.messageByteMeasurement: exact transferred UTF-8 snapshot payload; control-envelope overhead and decoded heap excluded

notes: One native DPR1 run; logical 60Hz scheduling is controlled, not measured FPS.
Preparation actual Game/runtime model replay with direct final ACKs; measured final ACKs come only from actual presentation after successful native draw and full readback.
Method timings inclusive and nested; do not sum nested categories. Worker callback excludes main receive/draw and is not an OS worker-thread timing.
Worker encodeTotal is JSON stringify plus TextEncoder encode; transferPost is actual structuredClone with transfer in the same process, no OS postMessage/delivery claim.
WireDecode records control envelopes too, for which decodeSnapshotWire is a cheap identity call; actual wire packet counts/bytes are separately recorded.

Output canvas resized to1x1 then event-loop yield/GC each output; stable/scratch/selection caches persist. Excludes PNG/video, app DOM/HUD/preview/rigid block rendering. No persistent-browser memory, FPS, GPU, or user-device claim.
Reference n and bitmap marked IDs/word bounds are exact loop-bound counts; bitset maintenance is separately counted, not assumed free.
One fixed baseline/candidate pair; source identity bound separately; no browser166ms attribution.
